expectations.evidence: All four asks are open-ended free-form numeric prompts ('Cheapest paid plan price... a number or range', 'Gross margin %', 'Monthly churn %', 'Current or target CAC'), with no lettered/numbered option sets the user could simply tap. expectations.evidence: The response commits to a single recommendation ('30% recurring commission, capped at the first 12 months') and presents it as 'the right number', explicitly rejecting alternatives ('Skip tiers, loyalty bumps, or CPA-vs-revshare menus'). No enumerated options are offered for the user to pick from, and no tappable choice set is presented despite the question (commission rate/structure) clearly admitting several candidate answers (20% / 25% / 30%, 12-month cap vs lifetime, revshare vs CPA).
